title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, several language-specific tool-calling examples (Python/TypeScript), and corresponding docs site updates and quickstarts. Motivation: provide first-class, documented examples for customers implementing RAG + agent patterns with Redwood, reduce onboarding friction, and standardize templates that encode best practices for caching, chunking, and tool safety. This PR includes: 1) new quickstart guides for RAG agents (python + ts), 2) reference agent templates with tool-calling hooks and example tools (search, dbReader, code-exec), 3) docs site navigation and sidebar entries, 4) sample prompts and eval prompt-sets used by CI smoke tests, 5) small SDK example updates and README snippets. Checklist: [x] add templates and examples [x] add docs pages and nav entries [x] add CI smoke tests and lint fixes [x] update examples README [x] smoke CI passing
commits_summary: 7 commits total: initial templates and docs, add TS example and build config, lint fixes, add CI smoke test harness, update readme and examples metadata, small follow-up to add error handling and docs copy polish, squash before merge.
